changes.before: | “Your data stays on your phone” | Current release has local storage/export and no server/account. Do not imply protection from someone with access to the unlocked device or from OS backups without explaining settings. |
changes.after: | “Stored locally. You choose where exports go.” | Ollo stores its settings and measurements on-device and has no server/account. User-selected exports can be saved through a cloud-backed Android document provider and remain outside app deletion. This does not protect data from someone with access to the unlocked device. |

changes.before: simple pixel animation of data staying inside a phone outline.
changes.after: simple pixel animation of Ollo storing its own settings on-device, with a separate user-chosen export path.

changes.before: Ollo keeps settings and measurements on your phone. No account, server, or internet permission in this build. Android access is still your choice.
changes.after: Ollo stores settings and measurements on your phone. You choose where exports go. No account, server, or internet permission in this build. Android access is still your choice.

changes.before: local storage does not mean exempt from device backup or physical access.
changes.after: distinguish app-owned local storage from user-selected exports, which may use a cloud provider and survive deletion in Ollo. Local storage does not prevent physical access.
